findings: The final app keeps the owner-approved soft-3D character, room, Powder Sky, Navy, and Cherry language from onboarding through Life, Trade, completion, and History.

The shared scene presenter adds bounded breathing, shallow parallax, practical-light drift, causal crossfades, and offscreen cancellation. Reduce Motion uses a settled crossfade-only plan with the same semantic state.
The completed iPad audit found and fixed a top safe-area collision. Current evidence keeps the system tab strip clear while the room remains full width.

All 24 visible indulgences have distinct authored selector art and deterministic family, arrival, and settled-state coverage. Eight destination pockets remain visually separate from the indulgence rather than using app screenshots.

The daily app adapts to Dark Mode. Onboarding deliberately preserves its owner-approved daylight art direction while still responding to increased contrast, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver semantics, and Reduce Motion.

The signed build installed on the available iPhone, but physical launch, device authentication, Image Playground success, and two-device CloudKit behavior remain external acceptance checks because the phone's device-service channel was unavailable.

ownerFeedback.note: The owner explicitly asked the agent to complete and verify the application. The final preserve pass has zero unresolved P0/P1 findings and retains the approved visual direction; physical capability checks remain truthfully separated from simulator and archive evidence.
